what_this_is: Host-performed verification that the private Task-A/Task-B mappings are unchanged and structurally sound before they are used to join responses. Mappings were NOT regenerated. No key, salt, filename or neutral-ID-to-condition association is published.
commitment_scheme: HMAC-SHA256(secret_salt, canonical_bytes). The salt is held privately and is NOT published. These commit to the actual populated artifacts, not to placeholders.
